answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The quill holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The canyon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
